one_sentence_story: You toss and wake up at tiny sounds on your first night in a hotel because your brain keeps its left half in light guard mode until it knows the room is safe.
so_what_for_you: Your sleep is not broken on trips: pack your own pillowcase from home or arrive two nights before a big morning meeting so the guard half of your brain can stand down.
